description: Data Set for Capacity Expansion Planning with Unit Commitment is a data set deposited in Monash University by its authors Semini Wijekoon, Ariel Liebman. This data set presents six test cases; 6 bus, 6bus ww, 14 bus, 15 bus, 21 bus and 24 bus, for generation, transmission and storage expansion planning problems. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 1727744 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
